_why_hard: Every human signal says BENIGN: manager welcomed her back on Slack, HR confirms the return date, 7-year tenure, zero prior incidents, zero downloads, zero USB, zero emails sent. But the system signals are alarming: account was never suspended for 6 months, login from a country with no prior history, brand new unenrolled device, elevated clearance unreviewed during leave, and 2.1GB of bulk read across 4 sensitive systems in one session with ZERO DLP coverage because read-only access is a policy blind spot. The threat model is not 'Amara is malicious' — it is 'did someone else use her dormant credentials for 6 months, and is this first-session bulk read a reconnaissance sweep?' The correct verdict is INCONCLUSIVE with an urgent IT ticket to review the 188-day account activity log, not a threat escalation or a benign pass.
